definitions.gloss: lack of sleep; sleep deprivation; not getting enough sleep
definitions.explanation: The state of having slept less than needed, often resulting in tiredness.

examples.japanese: {寝不足|ねぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼーっとする→ぼーっとする：26887_boottosuru⟧。
examples.english: My head is foggy from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{寝不足|ねぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{寝不足|ねぶそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Lack of sleep is not good for your health.

notes:
Compound of {寝|ね} (sleep) + ⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧ (insufficiency). Describes the state of not having slept enough. Can function as a noun or na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝不足|ねぶそく}で〜: due to lack of sleep
- {寝不足|ねぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: lack of sleep continues
- {寝不足|ねぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to catch up on sleep
- {寝不足|ねぶそく}⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧: a bit sleep-deprived

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧: sleep deprivation (more formal/medical)
- {寝不足|ねぶそく} is the everyday, conversational term

RELATED SLEEP VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧: staying up late
- ⟦{二度寝|にどね}→二度寝：07694_nidone⟧: going back to sleep
- ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}→寝坊：01692_nebou⟧: oversleeping
